$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). Presets use reserved example.com addresses, never a real person's.

tasks.name: reverse-email-lookup
tasks.title: Reverse email lookup: find every account registered to an email
tasks.description: Check one email address against 120+ online platforms, Instagram, GitHub, Discord, Amazon, Spotify and LinkedIn among them, and get each site where it has an account. Alert-free: the address owner is not notified. Replace the example address with yours.
tasks.seoTitle: Reverse Email Lookup - Find Accounts by Email
tasks.seoDescription: Find which of 120+ sites an email is registered on: Instagram, GitHub, Discord, Amazon, Spotify, LinkedIn and more. Alert-free, no login, no API key.

tasks.name: bulk-email-account-check
tasks.title: Bulk email check: the accounts behind each email in a list
tasks.description: Paste up to 100 email addresses and see, for each one, which of 120+ online platforms have an account registered to it, with a one-row summary per email. Addresses are cleaned and de-duplicated first. Alert-free.
tasks.seoTitle: Bulk Email OSINT - Check a List of Emails
tasks.seoDescription: Check up to 100 emails at once against 120+ platforms and see which sites each is registered on, one summary row per email. Alert-free, no login needed.

tasks.name: email-account-checker-full-report
tasks.title: Email account checker: the full report, registered and not
tasks.description: See every one of the 120+ platforms checked for an email address, with a row for each site where it is registered and each where it is not, so you know exactly what was covered. Alert-free.
tasks.seoTitle: Email Account Checker - Full 120+ Site Report
tasks.seoDescription: Check an email against 120+ sites and get a row for every site, registered or not, so the coverage is plain. Instagram, GitHub, Discord, Spotify and more.
